module pulse_detect(
    input clk, rst_n, data_in,
    output reg data_out
);
// Design Implementation
// Declare state variables
reg [1:0] state, next_state;
// Define state encoding
localparam STATE_S0 = 2'b00; // Initial state
localparam STATE_S1 = 2'b01; // After getting 0
localparam STATE_S2 = 2'b10; // After getting 01
localparam STATE_S3 = 2'b11; // After getting 010
// Sequential logic for state updates
always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) 
        state <= STATE_S0; // Reset state to S0
    else
        state <= next_state; // Update state to next_state
end
// Combinational logic for determining next_state
always @(*) begin
    case (state)
        STATE_S0: begin
            if (data_in == 1'b0) 
                next_state = STATE_S1; // Move to S1 if data_in is 0
            else 
                next_state = STATE_S0; // Stay in S0 if data_in is 1
        end
        
        STATE_S1: begin
            if (data_in == 1'b1) 
                next_state = STATE_S2; // Move to S2 if data_in is 1
            else 
                next_state = STATE_S1; // Stay in S1 if data_in is 0
        end
        
        STATE_S2: begin
            if (data_in == 1'b0) 
                next_state = STATE_S3; // Move to S3 if data_in is 0
            else 
                next_state = STATE_S0; // Go back to S0 if data_in is 1
        end
        
        STATE_S3: begin
            if (data_in == 1'b1) 
                next_state = STATE_S2; // Move to S2 if data_in is 1
            else 
                next_state = STATE_S1; // Move to S1 if data_in is 0
        end
        
        default: next_state = STATE_S0; // Default case to prevent latch inference
    endcase
end
// Combinational logic for data_out based on current state
always @(*) begin
    case (state)
        STATE_S0: data_out = 1'b0; // Set data_out to 0 in S0
        STATE_S1: data_out = 1'b0; // Set data_out to 0 in S1
        STATE_S2: data_out = (data_in == 1'b0) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0; // Set data_out to 1 if data_in is 0 in S2
        STATE_S3: data_out = 1'b0; // Set data_out to 0 in S3
        default: data_out = 1'b0; // Default case to prevent latch inference
    endcase
end
endmodule

<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse Detection Unit: Detects rising edges of a one-bit input signal and generates a pulse output when detected.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operations.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Asynchronous reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal for pulse detection.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <!-- Parameter Description Section -->
        <parameter id="STATE_INIT">Initial state of the FSM.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STATE_DATA_IN">State after detecting data_in = 1.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STATE_WAIT">State waiting for data_in to return to 0.</parameter>
        <parameter id="STATE_PULSE">State indicating the end of a pulse.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <!-- Sequential Logic Description Section -->
        <reg id="state">Register to store the current state of the FSM.</reg>
        
        <!-- State Transition Logic -->
        <always_comb>
            case(state)
                STATE_INIT: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state <= STATE_DATA_IN;
                    end else begin
                        next_state <= STATE_INIT;
                    end
                end
                
                STATE_DATA_IN: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state <= STATE_WAIT;
                    end else begin
                        next_state <= STATE_DATA_IN;
                    end
                end
                
                STATE_WAIT: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state <= STATE_PULSE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state <= STATE_WAIT;
                    end
                end
                
                STATE_PULSE: begin
                    next_state <= STATE_INIT;
                end
                
                default: next_state <= STATE_INIT;
            endcase
        </always_comb>
        
        // Register Update Logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n) begin
                state <= STATE_INIT;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
        
        // Output Generation Logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n) begin
                data_out <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    STATE_INIT: begin
                        data_out <= 1'b0;
                    end
                    
                    STATE_DATA_IN: begin
                        data_out <= 1'b0;
                    end
                    
                    STATE_WAIT: begin
                        data_out <= 1'b0;
                    end
                    
                    STATE_PULSE: begin
                        data_out <= 1'b1;
                    end
                    
                    default: data_out <= 1'b0;
                endcase
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        <!-- Combinational Logic Description Section -->
        // Add your implementation here
        
        // Data Type Definitions
        reg [1:0] state;
        reg [1:0] next_state;
        reg data_out;
        
        // State Encoding
        localparam STATE_INIT     = 2'd0,
                   STATE_DATA_IN  = 2'd1,
                   STATE_WAIT     = 2'd2,
                   STATE_PULSE    = 2'd3;
                   
        // Next State Logic
        always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                STATE_INIT: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = STATE_DATA_IN;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_INIT;
                    end
                end
                
                STATE_DATA_IN: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = STATE_WAIT;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_DATA_IN;
                    end
                end
                
                STATE_WAIT: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = STATE_PULSE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = STATE_WAIT;
                    end
                end
                
                STATE_PULSE: begin
                    next_state = STATE_INIT;
                end
                
                default: next_state = STATE_INIT;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Output Logic
        always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                STATE_INIT: begin
                    data_out = 1'b0;
                end
                
                STATE_DATA_IN: begin
                    data_out = 1'b0;
                end
                
                STATE_WAIT: begin
                    data_out = 1'b0;
                end
                
                STATE_PULSE: begin
                    data_out = 1'b1;
                end
                
                default: data_out = 1'b0;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Sequential Logic Block
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n) begin
                state <= STATE_INIT;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
